lines.textEn: Commander, welcome back to Frontier VII.
lines.textZh: 指挥官，欢迎回到第七前沿。

lines.textEn: The astral grid is stable for now — but entropy readings are climbing on the outer lanes.
lines.textZh: 航网暂时稳定，但外缘航线的熵读数正在攀升。

lines.textEn: Tip: select a located node on Explore to challenge a region directly.
lines.textZh: 提示：在探索界面选中已定位节点，可直接挑战对应区域。

lines.textEn: When you're ready, open Formation and deploy your combat deck.
lines.textZh: 准备好了就打开编队，部署你的战斗卡组。

lines.textEn: Commander — wake up. We're bleeding atmosphere on the outer lane.
lines.textZh: 指挥官，醒醒。外缘航线正在失压。

lines.textEn: Sweep drones are on our tail. Hold formation — I'll bring us in.
lines.textZh: 清扫无人机追上来了。保持编队，我来引导进港。

lines.textEn: Outer Haven beacon locked. We're alive — for now.
lines.textZh: 外缘港信标已锁定。我们还活着——暂时。

lines.textEn: Hull stress is high, but the crew held. Commander, we need reinforcements.
lines.textZh: 船体应力很高，但船员撑住了。指挥官，我们需要增援。

lines.textEn: A personnel beacon is still pinging in the debris field. Emergency recruit — now.
lines.textZh: 残骸带里还有人员信标在响。立刻紧急招募。

lines.textEn: Put me on the front line. Cole hits from the back — and change our combat strategy.
lines.textZh: 把我放前排。科尔打后排——再把战术调一下。

lines.textEn: See that? Focus fire on their back line — win rate jumps when Cole covers rear.
lines.textZh: 看到了吗？集火后排——科尔守住后方时胜率会跳升。

lines.textEn: Periodic signal southeast — mining spur, maybe. Probe it before the fog swallows it.
lines.textZh: 东南方有周期信号——可能是矿脉支线。趁熵雾还没吞掉它，先探测。

lines.textEn: Raiders on the spur run heavy plating. I'll strip their armor — push when I break them.
lines.textZh: 矿脉上的劫掠者装甲很厚。我来破甲——破防了就推进。

lines.textEn: Commander, open Fleet and tap Formation — we need at least one crew member in a deck.
lines.textZh: 指挥官，打开舰队并进入编队——我们得先往卡组里塞至少一名船员。

lines.textEn: Pick an empty slot in the lineup, then choose someone from the roster.
lines.textZh: 先点一个空位，再从名册里选人。

lines.textEn: Good. Now tap Join Deck to lock them in.
lines.textZh: 很好。现在点「加入卡组」确认编入。

lines.textEn: Star Map next — open Explore and challenge a region.
lines.textZh: 接下来去星图——打开探索，挑战一个区域。

lines.textEn: Select a located node, then start the battle. Win it to complete this step.
lines.textZh: 选中已定位的节点，然后开战。赢下这场才算完成本步。

lines.textEn: Back to Explore — we need raw materials from a gather node.
lines.textZh: 回到探索——我们需要从采集点弄点原材料。

lines.textEn: Start Gather on an unlocked region. Loot can also count if you already have some.
lines.textZh: 在已解锁区域点「开始采集」。若仓库里已有产物也算完成。

lines.textEn: Open Industry, then Crafting — turn those mats into something useful.
lines.textZh: 打开工业，再进制造——把材料做成能用的东西。

lines.textEn: Pick a recipe and tap Start. Output goes straight to Inventory.
lines.textZh: 选一条配方并点「开始」。产物会直接进入仓库。

lines.textEn: Visit Starport — buy or sell once at the NPC shop.
lines.textZh: 去星港——在 NPC 商店完成一次买或卖。

lines.textEn: Select an offer, then Buy or Sell once. Either direction counts.
lines.textZh: 选中一条商品，买或卖一次都行。
